# TenantModelKey

One of the tenant's own provider API keys ("bring your own key"), used when a run calls that provider's models and the run was not started with a key of its own. Keys are looked up at each model call, so disabling, replacing or deleting one takes effect on the next call of every run.

For each model call Maitento tries the keys supplied with the run, then the tenant's enabled keys for the provider by ascending `priority`, then Maitento's own key, but only when the run allows it and the tenant does not forbid it (`forbidMaitentoCredentials`).

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | [`ModelKeyProvider`](model-key-provider.md) | The vendor the key authenticates with. |
| `label` | `string` | A name for the key, chosen by the tenant (at most 100 characters). |
| `keyHint` | `string` | The key's last four characters, so a person can tell keys apart without the key being served. |
| `baseUrl` | `string \| null` | The endpoint to call instead of the provider's default, such as an Azure OpenAI resource or a regional Qwen host. Null for the provider's own endpoint. Always an absolute https URL to a public host. |
| `modelNameOverrides` | `map<string, string> \| null` | Maps a model's id at the provider (such as `gpt-4.1-mini`) to the name this key's endpoint serves it under, such as an Azure deployment name. Null or empty: model names are sent unchanged. |
| `priority` | `integer` | The order the tenant's keys for one provider are tried in; lower first. |
| `isDisabled` | `boolean` | Whether the key is disabled. A disabled key is kept but never used. |
| `userCreatedById` | `uuid` | The id of the user who created it. A call made with an API key is recorded as the key's user. |
| `tenantId` | `uuid` | The id of the tenant it belongs to. |
| `id` | `uuid` | The unique id. Use it in `by-id` routes and wherever another object refers to this one. |
| `dateCreated` | `datetime` | When it was created, in UTC. |
| `dateUpdated` | `datetime` | When it was last changed, in UTC. |

## Example

```json
{
  "provider": "Anthropic",
  "label": "...",
  "keyHint": "...",
  "baseUrl": "...",
  "modelNameOverrides": {
    "key": "..."
  },
  "priority": 0,
  "isDisabled": false,
  "userCreatedById": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "tenantId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "dateCreated": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z",
  "dateUpdated": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z"
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`modelKeys.create`](../api/model-keys.md) (`POST /tenants/self/model-keys`)
- [`modelKeys.list`](../api/model-keys.md) (`GET /tenants/self/model-keys`)
- [`modelKeys.update`](../api/model-keys.md) (`PUT /tenants/self/model-keys/by-id/{id}`)
